channel.title: Wire — Node.js
channel.description: Node.js from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: The team behind Tailwind CSS is joining Shopify
item.description: We're joining Shopify to give Tailwind a stable long-term home where it will be actively maintained for the millions of people who depend on it. (5 sources: frontendfocus, hackernews, nodeweekly, reactstatus, rubyweekly)

item.title: a CVSS 10.0 sandbox escape in vm2
item.description: GitLab's Threat Research Group found a critical sandbox escape in vm2 that runs attacker code using the library's own documented configuration. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Matteo Collina staying Chair and Rafael Gonzaga becoming Vice-Chair
item.description: May was the month for TSC Elections, but last year I took over from Micheal in July, and I totally slipped. I'm sorry. Last year we elected a Chair and a Vice-chair and I assume we'd do the same this year. The proposed schedule is: Aug 1... (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Fuzzing the State Machines Inside My HTTP Client
item.description: ffetch had a full suite of passing tests for retries, hedging, timeouts, and cancellation. Describing the rules instead of the cases, and letting fast-check generate network outcomes and timings, found eleven real defects. (1 source: nodeweekly)
